<details>
<summary>页脚HTML代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-html">&lt;!-- =====================================================
     页脚 HTML / JavaScript
     Theme : Pixyll Minimalist  |  Author: JayZorn
     ===================================================== --&gt;

&lt;!-- § 1. 隐藏 [Ctrl+Enter] 提示 --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
function hideStubbornElements() {
    $("p, span").each(function () {
        if ($(this).text().indexOf("Ctrl+Enter") &gt;= 0) $(this).hide();
    });
}
$(document).ajaxComplete(hideStubbornElements);
var _cleanCount = 0;
var _cleanTimer = setInterval(function () {
    hideStubbornElements();
    if (++_cleanCount &gt;= 10) clearInterval(_cleanTimer);
}, 500);
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 2. 自定义标签页图标（favicon） --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
(function () {
    var link = document.querySelector("link[rel*='icon']") || document.createElement('link');
    link.type = 'image/x-icon';
    link.rel  = 'shortcut icon';
    link.href = 'https://blog-static.cnblogs.com/files/blogs/827007/output.ico?t=1771785298&amp;download=true';
    document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(link);
})();
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 3. 正文右侧浮动目录面板 (TOC) - 修复滚动越界问题 --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
$(function () {
    if (!/\/p\/\d+/.test(window.location.href)) return;

    var postBody = document.getElementById('cnblogs_post_body') || document.getElementById('post_detail') || document.getElementById('mainContent');
    if (!postBody) return;

    var headings = Array.prototype.slice.call(postBody.querySelectorAll('h2, h3')).filter(function (h) { return h.textContent.trim().length &gt; 0; });
    if (headings.length &lt; 1) return;

    headings.forEach(function (h, i) { if (!h.id) h.id = 'toc-h-' + i; });

    var panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.id  = 'pixyll-toc-panel';

    var title = document.createElement('p');
    title.className = 'toc-heading';
    title.textContent = 'Contents';
    panel.appendChild(title);

    var links = [];
    headings.forEach(function (h) {
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = '#' + h.id;
        a.textContent = h.textContent.trim();
        a.className = (h.tagName === 'H3') ? 'toc-h3' : '';
        a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.scrollTo({ top: h.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 24, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
        panel.appendChild(a);
        links.push({ el: a, heading: h });
    });

    document.body.appendChild(panel);

    var rafPending = false;
    function updateActive() {
        rafPending = false;
        var scrollTop = window.pageYOffset;
        
        // 1. 高亮当前阅读的标题
        var cur = null;
        headings.forEach(function (h) { if (h.offsetTop &lt;= scrollTop + 80) cur = h; });
        links.forEach(function (item) { item.el.classList.toggle('toc-active', item.heading === cur); });

        // 2. 限制 TOC 面板不要滚动到评论区
        var postBottom = postBody.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + window.pageYOffset;
        var panelHeight = panel.offsetHeight;
        
        // 如果当前滚动位置 + 面板高度 超出了正文底部，则切换为绝对定位停在底部
        if (scrollTop + 120 + panelHeight &gt; postBottom) {
            panel.style.position = 'absolute';
            panel.style.top = (postBottom - panelHeight) + 'px';
        } else {
            panel.style.position = 'fixed';
            panel.style.top = '120px';
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
        if (!rafPending) { rafPending = true; requestAnimationFrame(updateActive); }
    }, { passive: true });

    updateActive();
});
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 4. 惯性平滑滚动 --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
(function () {
    var SPEED = 0.03, WHEEL_MUL = 1.2, current = window.pageYOffset, target = current, ticking = false;
    function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
    function loop() {
        var maxY = Math.max(Math.max(document.body.scrollHeight, document.documentElement.scrollHeight) - window.innerHeight, 0);
        target = Math.max(0, Math.min(target, maxY));
        current = lerp(current, target, SPEED);
        if (Math.abs(target - current) &lt; 0.5) { current = target; ticking = false; window.scrollTo(0, current); return; }
        window.scrollTo(0, current);
        requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    var isMidScroll = false;
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (e.button === 1) { isMidScroll = true; current = target = window.pageYOffset; ticking = false; } });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { if (e.button === 1) { isMidScroll = false; current = target = window.pageYOffset; } });
    function onWheel(e) {
        if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || isMidScroll) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        target += ((e.deltaMode === 1) ? e.deltaY * 28 : e.deltaY) * WHEEL_MUL;
        if (!ticking) { current = window.pageYOffset; ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    }
    window.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { current = target = window.pageYOffset; });
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!ticking) { current = target = window.pageYOffset; } });
})();
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 5. 支持 / 反对 内联到 postDesc --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
$(function () {
    if (!/\/p\/\d+/.test(window.location.href)) return;
    var postDesc = document.querySelector('.postDesc');
    if (!postDesc) return;

    function getCount(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? (parseInt(el.textContent.trim(), 10) || 0) : 0; }
    function syncCounts() {
        var da = document.getElementById('pixyll-digg-a'), ba = document.getElementById('pixyll-bury-a');
        if (da) da.textContent = '\u652F\u6301(' + getCount('digg_count') + ')';
        if (ba) ba.textContent = '\u53CD\u5BF9(' + getCount('bury_count') + ')';
    }

    function buildLinks() {
        if (document.getElementById('pixyll-inline-digg')) { syncCounts(); return; }
        var wrap = document.createElement('span'); wrap.id = 'pixyll-inline-digg';
        
        var diggA = document.createElement('a'); diggA.id = 'pixyll-digg-a'; diggA.href = 'javascript:void(0)';
        diggA.onclick = function () { var btn = document.querySelector('.diggit input, .diggit'); if (btn) btn.click(); setTimeout(syncCounts, 1500); };
        
        var sep = document.createElement('span'); sep.textContent = ' ';
        
        var buryA = document.createElement('a'); buryA.id = 'pixyll-bury-a'; buryA.href = 'javascript:void(0)';
        buryA.onclick = function () { var btn = document.querySelector('.buryit input, .buryit'); if (btn) btn.click(); setTimeout(syncCounts, 1500); };
        
        wrap.appendChild(diggA); wrap.appendChild(sep); wrap.appendChild(buryA);
        var dot = document.createElement('span'); dot.textContent = ' \u00b7 ';
        postDesc.appendChild(dot); postDesc.appendChild(wrap);
        syncCounts();

        var divDigg = document.getElementById('div_digg');
        if (divDigg) new MutationObserver(syncCounts).observe(divDigg, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    }

    var tried = 0, timer = setInterval(function () {
        tried++;
        if (document.getElementById('digg_count')) { clearInterval(timer); buildLinks(); } 
        else if (tried &gt;= 30) { clearInterval(timer); }
    }, 200);
});
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 6. 订阅此文 链接 + RSS 弹窗 --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
$(function () {
    if (!/\/p\/\d+/.test(window.location.href)) return;
    var postDesc = document.querySelector('.postDesc');
    if (!postDesc || document.getElementById('pixyll-rss-a')) return;

    var match = window.location.pathname.match(/^\/([^\/]+)\/p\//);
    if (!match) return;
    var rssHref = 'https://www.cnblogs.com/' + match[1] + '/rss';

    var overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.id = 'pixyll-rss-overlay';
    Object.assign(overlay.style, { display: 'none', position: 'fixed', top: '0', left: '0', width: '100%', height: '100%', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)', zIndex: '99998' });

    var box = document.createElement('div');
    Object.assign(box.style, { position: 'absolute', top: '50%', left: '50%', transform: 'translate(-50%,-50%)', background: '#fff', padding: '36px 40px 28px', width: '320px', boxSizing: 'border-box', boxShadow: '0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)', fontFamily: '"Playfair Display","Songti SC","SimSun",serif' });

    var title = document.createElement('p'); title.textContent = '\u8BA2\u9605\u6B64\u535A\u5BA2';
    Object.assign(title.style, { fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: '700', color: '#111', margin: '0 0 20px 0' });

    var row = document.createElement('div'); Object.assign(row.style, { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '24px' });
    var input = document.createElement('input'); input.type = 'text'; input.value = rssHref; input.readOnly = true;
    Object.assign(input.style, { flex: '1', border: '1px solid #ddd', padding: '7px 10px', fontSize: '13px', fontFamily: 'inherit', color: '#555', outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box' });

    var copyBtn = document.createElement('button'); copyBtn.textContent = '\u590D\u5236';
    Object.assign(copyBtn.style, { border: '1px solid #111', background: '#111', color: '#fff', padding: '7px 14px', fontSize: '13px', fontFamily: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', flexShrink: '0' });
    copyBtn.onclick = function () { input.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); copyBtn.textContent = '\u5DF2\u590D\u5236'; setTimeout(function () { copyBtn.textContent = '\u590D\u5236'; }, 1500); };

    var closeBtn = document.createElement('a'); closeBtn.href = 'javascript:void(0)'; closeBtn.textContent = '\u5173\u95ED';
    Object.assign(closeBtn.style, { fontSize: '13px', color: '#bbb', textDecoration: 'none', display: 'block', textAlign: 'right' });
    closeBtn.onclick = function () { overlay.style.display = 'none'; };
    overlay.onclick = function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none'; };

    row.appendChild(input); row.appendChild(copyBtn); box.appendChild(title); box.appendChild(row); box.appendChild(closeBtn); overlay.appendChild(box); document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    var newA = document.createElement('a'); newA.id = 'pixyll-rss-a'; newA.href = 'javascript:void(0)'; newA.textContent = '\u8BA2\u9605\u6B64\u6587';
    newA.onclick = function () { overlay.style.display = 'block'; };
    var dot = document.createElement('span'); dot.textContent = ' \u00b7 ';
    postDesc.appendChild(dot); postDesc.appendChild(newA);
});
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 7. 页面切换淡入淡出 --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
(function () {
    var root = document.documentElement;
    function showPage() { requestAnimationFrame(function () { requestAnimationFrame(function () { root.style.opacity = '1'; }); }); }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', showPage); } else { showPage(); }
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function () { showPage(); });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') showPage(); });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var a = e.target.closest('a');
        if (!a || !a.href || a.target === '_blank' || a.href.indexOf('javascript') === 0 || (a.getAttribute('href') || '').indexOf('#') === 0 || a.hostname !== window.location.hostname) return;
        e.preventDefault(); root.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(function () { window.location.href = a.href; }, 240);
    });
})();
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 8. 隐藏 .blogStats --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
$(function () { var stats = document.querySelector('.blogStats'); if (stats) stats.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); });
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- § 9. 文章页二级导航栏 + 主页分割线 --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
$(function () {
    var isPost = /\/p\/\d+/.test(window.location.href), header = document.getElementById('header');
    if (!isPost) {
        if (header) { var hr = document.createElement('hr'); hr.id = 'pixyll-home-divider'; header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', hr); }
        return;
    }

    var bt = document.getElementById('blogTitle'); if (bt) bt.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    if (!header) return;

    var dateText = '', postDesc = document.querySelector('.postDesc');
    if (postDesc) { var m = postDesc.textContent.match(/\d{4}[-\/]\d{1,2}[-\/]\d{1,2}/); if (m) dateText = m[0]; }

    var blogName = '', blogTitleEl = document.querySelector('#blogTitle h1 a');
    if (blogTitleEl) blogName = blogTitleEl.textContent.trim();

    var nav = document.createElement('div'); nav.id = 'pixyll-subnav';
    var homeA = document.createElement('a'); homeA.href = 'https://www.cnblogs.com/jayzorn-ljz/'; homeA.textContent = '\u2190 \u4e3b\u9875'; nav.appendChild(homeA);
    if (blogName) { var nameA = document.createElement('a'); nameA.href = 'https://www.cnblogs.com/jayzorn-ljz/'; nameA.textContent = blogName; nav.appendChild(nameA); }
    if (dateText) { var dateSpan = document.createElement('span'); dateSpan.className = 'subnav-date'; dateSpan.textContent = dateText; nav.appendChild(dateSpan); }

    [{ text: 'GitHub', href: 'https://github.com/JayZorn-LJZ' }, { text: 'X', href: 'https://x.com/jayzorn_ljz' }].forEach(function (item) {
        var a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = item.href; a.target = '_blank'; a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; a.textContent = item.text + ' \u21d7'; nav.appendChild(a);
    });
    header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', nav);
});
&lt;/script&gt;
</code></pre>
</details>
<hr>
<h2 id="特点">特点</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>🌞 基于<strong>SimpleMemory</strong>皮肤设计得来。只需开通js权限，更换好simplememory皮肤，将上述代码添加到对应的设置框中保存即可获得同款皮肤</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>😆 <strong>vibe coding 所得</strong>（半天的头脑风暴，在Gemini、Claude、qwen、kimi之间辗转）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>🌟 <strong>很简洁</strong>，隐藏了很多元素，详细内容待各位阅读代码（注释Claude已经给我们留的很详细啦）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>🙃 <strong>不易上手</strong>，没有“首页”、“博客园”等超链接。但是记住，“作者”的名字就是个任意门（All roads lead to Rome.）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>🥷 <strong>信息量低</strong>。除了正文内容，很难发掘作者其他信息</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>🤖 （摘自Claude）Pixyll Minimalist — 版本特点总结：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>设计风格</strong><br>
极简主义，以大量留白和克制的排版取代装饰性元素。整体气质接近西文文学杂志：衬线字体、黑白灰主色调、无多余视觉噪音</li>
<li><strong>字体系统</strong><br>
英文使用 Playfair Display（高对比几何衬线），中文自动 fallback 至系统宋体，两者在视觉气质上高度契合。代码块单独使用等宽字体，与正文明确区隔</li>
<li><strong>布局</strong><br>
强制单栏居中，彻底隐藏 SimpleMemory 的侧边栏，并通过多层容器（#forFlow、#mainContent、.forFlow）的偏移清除，消除了原两栏布局遗留的 margin/float 残留问题。PC 端限宽 1020px，移动端全宽自适应</li>
<li><strong>文章列表节奏</strong><br>
所有相邻文章之间——无论是否跨天——均为统一的 56px 间距加细线分隔，视觉节奏完全一致。通过 .dayTitle + .postTitle 精准匹配 SimpleMemory 的 HTML 结构，解决了跨天首篇分隔线缺失的问题</li>
<li><strong>代码块</strong><br>
深色背景统一白色文字，覆盖了 highlight.js 全部 token 颜色。行内代码使用浅灰背景加粉色强调，与块级代码形成两级视觉层次</li>
<li><strong>评论区</strong><br>
输入框、Tab、按钮统一为"细边框方角 + hover 变黑"的交互语言，与正文排版风格一致。提交按钮为实心黑底</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>🤩 <strong>好看</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>🔨 <strong>还有很多地方需要打磨</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
